## Summary

Describe the problem and the change.

## Validation

List the commands and manual checks that passed.

## Screenshots

Include before and after images for visible changes. Redact network and account details.

## Checklist

- [ ] The product name is `NetPulse` in all new text and metadata.
- [ ] `swift test --arch arm64` passes.
- [ ] The release build and arm64 bundle checks pass when the change affects runtime code or packaging.
- [ ] Parser or diagnostic changes include tests with sanitized fixtures.
- [ ] User-facing text is updated in English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
- [ ] Public documentation and release text are in English.
- [ ] Privacy and network-access documentation is updated when applicable.
- [ ] No real SSID, public IP, hostname, device name, account name, or secret is included.
